messages:
Michael: Heads up — we need a quick cross-team alignment on the on-prem metrics export handshake and what runtime fields we surface in the Console. Found two gaps during the private onboarding test: agent handshake failures (firewall/KMS) and missing ingestion visibility on dashboards.
Ava: Saw that in the test run. Agent retries masked a 403 from customer firewall, and the console just showed 'no data' with no helpful reason.
Raj: For the handshake payload we want a minimal stable schema. Proposal below. Need product + infra signoff on required fields.
Raj: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_1234",
  "deployment_id": "dep-001",
  "agent_version": "1.4.2",
  "metric_namespace": "runtime.metrics",
  "sample_rate": 0.1,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T15:12:34Z"
}
```
Ava: Also add `host_fqdn` and `export_mode` (push/pull) — UX needs those to show topology.
Raj: ok add `host_fqdn` and `export_mode`. We also need a signature header to validate payloads: `X-RW-Signature: sha256=...` signed by customer's KMS wrapper or Redwood-managed key depending on deployment mode.
Ivan: From infra: firewall checklist for customers — outbound to metrics.ingest.redwood.ai:443, plus allow handshakes to auth.redwood.ai for token exchange. We'll publish concrete IP ranges but teams should code to hostname-only (TLS cert validation).
Sara: On Console side, we need three views: ingestion status (per-deploy health + last successful handshake), per-metric ingestion rate chart, and an audit hook list (KMS signing_key_id, last_rotate_ts). If handshake fails we should show the HTTP code and last error blob.
Michael: Important: include an `audit_request_id` in the handshake response path so customer's audit logs can tie events back. Also need to agree on retention for handshake logs (default 90 days, opt-in 365).
Raj: Runtime note: we'll surface `handshake_state` enum: PENDING, ACTIVE, DEGRADED, FAILED. And `backoff_ms` for agent to respect automated backoff.
Ava: UX: can we show a sample curl to help customers open firewall? e.g.:
Ava: ```bash
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"customer_id":"cust_1234"}' https://metrics.ingest.redwood.ai/handshake
```
Ivan: We'll also publish an agent troubleshooting doc with `tcpdump` one-liners and required egress ports (443 + 80 for legacy token fetch). But highlight TLS + SNI so proxies don't break routing.
telemetry-bot: Deploy note: runtime/1.4.2 -> canary 10% today 19:00 UTC, rollback window 30m.
Sara: UX question: do we want an explicit toggle to surface raw handshake payloads in Console (for enterprise customers) or only parsed fields? My vote: parsed by default, raw available behind a 'show raw' link when user has audit role.
Raj: Agree. Parsed for day-to-day, raw for audits. We'll include `raw_payload_blob` in the audit logs but only store if enterprise audit retention enabled.
Michael: Quotas: agents should be rate-limited (by deployment) for handshake calls: 1/min default with token bucket. We'll need product to confirm limits and infra to enforce at ingress.
Ava: Also add `agent_debug_level` header to temporarily raise logging during a support window.
Ivan: Action items: I will publish IP ranges + egress checklist by EOW, and expose a JSON endpoint for infra-to-ingest handshake metadata.
Sara: Action: I'll wire the Console pages and add a 'handshake timeline' panel. ETA 2 sprints.
Raj: Action: I'll add fields to runtime payload, signature validation, and backoff headers. Will bump agent SDK and publish changelog.
Michael: I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 14:30 UTC to finalize the schema and signoffs. If you can't make it, drop a comment in this thread.
Ava: +1. Also would like QA to add a negative test for proxy mangling of SNI.
telemetry-bot: Reminder: add `handshake_state` to the pipeline mapping PR before merging.
Michael: Thanks all :thumbsup: Let’s keep the handshake schema minimal and the Console helpful — avoid 'no data' dead-ends.
